capabilities: sync vault files between desktop and mobile with automatic local and remote change detection
merge concurrent edits line-by-line and keep conflict copies when the same lines change
surface pending conflicts in the sync receipt, ribbon, and settings with one-click navigation
view and restore individual file history versions
enable per-repository end-to-end encryption and manage multiple remote repositories per account
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Free tier with quota limits; paid plans add storage and features. Unencrypted repositories are stored in plaintext on the server; E2EE passwords never leave the device and cannot be recovered if lost. Loads a customer-service QR image from rrecurenceEngine.com when opening the About section; sends minimal error diagnostics by default (opt-out in Settings, kept up to 90 days). Optimized for China networks without extra proxy tools. Full data-handling details are in an external privacy policy.
problem: Obsidian stores notes locally with no built-in cross-device sync, and existing sync options can lose data or are hard to use from mainland China networks.
